scripts.build: rm -rf lib && npm run format && tsc -p ./tsconfig.production.json && node ../write-package-entrypoint.mjs rtp
scripts.ci: npm run type && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.deploy:alpha: npm run build && npm publish --tag alpha
scripts.test: npm run type && npm run type:public && vitest run ./tests
scripts.test:browser: cd browser-e2e && npm install && npm run ci:silent
scripts.type:public: rm -rf .tmp-decl && tsc -p tsconfig.production.json --outDir .tmp-decl && tsc -p tools/publicTypes/tsconfig.json; r=$?; rm -rf .tmp-decl; exit $r
